lesson.meaning: Happening or existing at the exact same time.
examples: We need to work on multiple tasks simultaneously to meet the project deadline.
The software update allowed for simultaneous editing by different team members.
During the press conference, the news was translated into several languages simultaneously.
It's hard to listen to music and have a serious conversation simultaneously.
The company launched its new product in three different markets simultaneously.
lesson.memory_tip: Think of 'same time' – 'simultaneous' means things are happening at the *same time*.
